image_description: A close-up view of a pipe organ console and the lower section of the pipe facade. The image features multiple wooden manuals (keyboards), stop tablets on angled jambs, a music rack with sheet music, and vertical metallic pipes in the background housed within a wooden case.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Vertical metallic pipes are clearly visible in the background, arranged in groups behind wooden dividers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the top; the full height and 'towering' nature of the pipes cannot be verified, nor can the full stepped silhouette be seen.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Rows of stop tablets are clearly visible on the angled panels (jambs) flanking the keyboards.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible pipes have a distinct metallic sheen and color consistent with polished tin or lead alloys.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The musical notation on the sheets appears as vague black blobs and lines rather than distinct, legible notes and staves, typical of AI struggling with fine print.
The stop tablets on the right appear to merge into the wood casing without clear separation or depth; some labels look like melted smudges rather than distinct physical objects.
The alignment of the white and black keys on the upper manual shows slight waviness and inconsistent spacing, deviating from the rigid geometric precision expected of a real instrument.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomical classification of the instrument and distinguish it from other keyboard instruments.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility of the musical notation and stop labels, which are high-risk areas for AI artifacts.
To check for fusion between the stop controls and the wooden jambs, and to ensure keys are distinct entities.
To verify the spatial relationship between the foreground console and the background pipes, ensuring no impossible blending.

focus_areas: Legibility of musical notation on the stand
Structural integrity and separation of stop tablets
Boundary sharpness between pipes and wooden casing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the sheet music; AI often generates 'fake text' that looks like music from a distance but fails under scrutiny. Also, inspect the right-hand stop jamb for signs of melting or lack of depth, as this is a common failure point in complex mechanical interfaces.
